name: Living
overview: Living, as revealed in Scripture, begins with God's creation of man as a living soul, formed from the dust and given life by God's breath (Genesis 2:7). God’s plans for our lives are purposeful and filled with hope, promising peace and an expected future (Jeremiah 29:11). True living is marked by transformation through the renewing of the mind, enabling believers to discern and follow the good and perfect will of God rather than conforming to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2). This foundation supports various aspects of living, including daily Christian living, godly conduct, and the pursuit of a healthy, Christ-centered life.
